subject: Hotel deposit authorization gap — need emergency virtual card for Acme workshop
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, events@hiltondowntown.com
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hotel deposit authorization gap — need emergency virtual card for Acme workshop

Hi team,

Planning note: Acme Financial confirmed the onsite workshop for July 12-13, and Hilton is asking for a $4,200 deposit to hold the room block. Their events team says the deposit must be guaranteed by Friday (06/25) or they’ll release the block.

Problem: our corporate card used to place the original tentative hold was declined when they attempted the follow-up authorization yesterday due to an authorization timing window mismatch (bank flagged multiple authorizations as potential fraud). Hilton attempted to capture the hold and got a decline. They’re asking for a guaranteed payment method to avoid losing the block.

Can Finance issue an emergency virtual card for the deposit (one-time charge) or advise an alternative guarantee we can provide that meets Hilton’s timeline? I’ve attached the Hilton deposit invoice and the booking summary.

Key asks:
- Marissa / Finance: can we get a virtual card for $4,200 that expires after charge? If so, what info do you need (last 4 digits, billing name, expiry)?
- Neha / Sales Ops: please coordinate with Hilton and Acme on any flexibility window and confirm whether ACME can temporarily cover the deposit via their PO (unlikely based on last call).

Samantha, thanks for flagging — can you confirm whether Acme can move the workshop by a week if necessary? We’re pushing to avoid that.

Thanks,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: Hilton_Deposit_Invoice_Jun2026.pdf (invoice, $4,200)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmefinancial.com>, events@hiltondowntown.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hotel deposit authorization gap — need emergency virtual card for Acme workshop

On Sat, Jun 20, 2026 at 09:12 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Planning note: Acme Financial confirmed the onsite workshop for July 12-13, and Hilton is asking for a $4,200 deposit to hold the room block.

Thanks for the heads up, Mateo. We can issue a single-use virtual card for vendor deposits, but I need the following to spin it up immediately:
- Exact vendor billing name and address (as it appears on the invoice)
- Invoice number and amount (I see invoice attached)
- Expected merchant MCC (hotel/lodging is fine)
- Cardholder name (we generally use "Redwood Inference Events")

Assuming we have that, target turnaround is ~2 business days for the v-card to be live. We can also set a single-merchant authorization limit to reduce risk. If Hilton needs the guarantee sooner than 48 hours, we can provision an expedited approval but will need VP sign-off for emergency spend over $3k (flagging @finance-head).

I’ll queue this and will follow up once the v-card is created.

-Marissa
VP, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: none
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmefinancial.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, events@hiltondowntown.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hotel deposit authorization gap — need emergency virtual card for Acme workshop

Thanks Mateo — we can confirm Acme does not have an internal policy that covers third-party vendor deposits for workshops. They can reimburse Redwood after the fact, but they can’t issue the deposit directly to Hilton.

Hilton is holding the block through EOD Friday but said they’ll release if deposit isn’t received. If you can provide a card guarantee, we’ll keep the dates. If not, we’ll need to look at alternate hotels or shift the workshop to the week of July 19.

Invoice reference: HIL-INV-6126, Deposit $4,200. Billing address: Hilton Downtown, 100 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103.

Samantha Ortiz
Senior Program Manager, Events
Acme Financial
samantha.ortiz@acmefinancial.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, events@hiltondowntown.com
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@acmefinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hotel deposit authorization gap — need emergency virtual card for Acme workshop

Marissa — thanks. Vendor billing name/address matches the invoice (Hilton Downtown, 100 Market St, SF). Invoice HIL-INV-6126, $4,200. Cardholder name: Redwood Inference Events. Merchant MCC: 7011 (Hotels).

Neha — can you confirm if we have a VP approval for an expedited v-card under this dollar threshold? If not, I can loop in Lisa (SVP Sales) for quick sign-off — we’d prefer not to lose the block.

Hilton events team — please hold the block through 11:59pm PT on Friday 06/25 if possible while we finalize payment. If the virtual card goes through, we’ll ask Hilton to capture $4,200 and then submit expense through Concur.

Thanks,
Mateo

Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hotel deposit authorization gap — need emergency virtual card for Acme workshop

Update: I created a single-use virtual card for Hilton (single merchant, $4,350 limit, expires 07/01/2026). The card details were sent securely via our payment portal to "events@hiltondowntown.com" and copied to Mateo. Please confirm receipt and that they were able to process the deposit (invoice HIL-INV-6126).

Next steps for Mateo/Acme: once the deposit posts, please upload the Hilton invoice and any receipts to Concur under the ACME-2026-WORKSHOP request so Finance can reconcile and process reimbursement. I’ve included the Concur request link in related_links. We’ll treat this as an advance that will be reconciled post-event.

Marissa Cole
VP, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Hilton_Deposit_Invoice_Jun2026.pdf (confirmed sent to vendor), boarding_pass_mateo_0624.pdf (for travel reconciliation)
